aiAssistant.title: Assistant IA
aiAssistant.description: Posez des questions sur l'environnement McHarbor sélectionné.
aiAssistant.footer: Context is shared across McHarbor. Addons can extend capabilities via @resources/ai.
aiAssistant.backendUnavailable: Sorry — the AI backend is not configured or is unavailable. Open Settings → AI to configure an API key.
aiAssistant.rateLimited: Le fournisseur d'IA a atteint sa limite de requêtes. Patientez un instant puis réessayez, ou changez de fournisseur dans Paramètres > IA.

actions.title: Action IA en attente
actions.description: Vérifiez le plan à blanc avant que McHarbor ne modifie quoi que ce soit.

prompts.container: Explain this container: what it does, its current state, and any recent errors in the last 50 log lines.
prompts.stack: Summarise this stack, its services, and any deployment errors.
prompts.image: What does this image do, and are there any recommended settings or known issues?
prompts.volume: What data is stored on this volume, and what containers depend on it?
prompts.network: Describe this network, the containers attached to it, and any connectivity issues.
prompts.pod: Explain this pod, its containers, and any recent failures.
prompts.deployment: Summarise this deployment, its replicas, and any rollout issues.
prompts.workflow: Explain the most recent failure in this workflow, if any.
prompts.environment: Give me a quick overview of this environment: containers, images, and stacks.
prompts.fallback: Give me a quick overview of the current McHarbor setup.

capability.confirmBody: The AI wants to run "{{label}}". This cannot be undone.

oauth.connectHelp: Sign in with your provider — McHarbor stores an OAuth token, no API key needed.
oauth.githubHint: GitHub Models uses your existing GitHub account. You need Copilot access for premium models.
oauth.anthropicHint: Coming soon. Anthropic currently only ships API keys.
oauth.beginHelp: Ouvrez l'URL, saisissez le code, puis approuvez l'acces.
